title: Welcome to Turing Town
transcript: Welcome to Turing Town. A quiet little town. Friendly neighbors. Nothing strange going on here… right?

title: Someone moved in
transcript: Wrong. AI bots have slipped into town, disguised as residents. They look like you. They type like you. And they want to stay.

title: The town survey
transcript: First, the town survey. Answer a few questions about yourself. Don't worry: nobody else ever sees your answers.

title: Five quick questions
transcript: Now, five questions and two minutes. This time the whole town sees what you write, so answer like yourself. No real names, and nothing personal.

title: Who seems off?
transcript: Time's up. Read your neighbors carefully, then tap the one who seems a little off. Nobody leaves yet. But the town remembers.

title: The suspicion meter
transcript: The town has spoken. Well, whispered. The higher your meter, the more eyes are on you.

title: One more question
transcript: One more question. Nobody sees your answer just yet. One of these may come back to haunt somebody.

title: The hot seat
transcript: Somebody is taking the hot seat. Suspicion loads the dice, but luck rolls them.

title: Did they say that?
transcript: Here is the answer under their name. Careful: it is probably not theirs. Question them, and see how they handle it.

title: The town square
transcript: To the town square. Everything is fair game: the answers, the meter, the hot seat. Talk it out.

title: One vote
transcript: This is the only vote that counts. Catch a bot and the humans win. Miss, and the town belongs to them.

title: The verdict
transcript: The votes are in. Let's see who has been living next door.

title: Humans win
transcript: Got one! The town is safe tonight. Lock your doors anyway.

title: The bots win
transcript: Oh dear. That was one of your own. The bots would like to thank you for your hospitality.

title: No verdict
transcript: No verdict. The town went to bed arguing, and the bots slept very well.

title: The truth
transcript: And that hot seat answer? It really was theirs.

title: The truth
transcript: And that hot seat answer? Somebody else wrote it.

title: Goodbye
transcript: Thanks for playing!

title: Goodbye
transcript: The town will remember this.

title: Goodbye
transcript: No neighbors were permanently deleted.

title: Goodbye
transcript: Trust is rebuilding. Please allow 3 to 5 business days.

title: Goodbye
transcript: Somewhere, a bot is taking notes for next time.

title: Goodbye
transcript: If you were wrongly accused, you may sulk now.

title: Goodbye
transcript: Lock your doors. Check your friends.

title: Goodbye
transcript: Same town tomorrow? Bring a better alibi.

title: Goodbye
transcript: Be honest. You sounded a little robotic too.
